about_the_game:
Drumonic is an app that was created to make learning the drums fun, interactive, and accessible. Whether you’re just starting out, run a school or brushing up on your rhythm skills, you’ll find tools here to practice along with real songs and improve at your own pace.

Drumonic is an app for learning drums through play, not pressure. Whether you’re a total beginner or just want to jam to your favourite tracks, Drumonic makes learning fast, fun, and affordable; just the way it was meant to be.

Connecting your electronic drum kit gives you real-time feedback and lets you play along with 106 lessons and songs, but you can also play along on an acoustic set.

Drumonic uses intuitive rolling note visuals synced to real drum animations, so you can see exactly what to hit and when. You even get hit statistics and suggestions on what to practise on.

From popular classic pop, metal and rock songs to funky fills, grooves and even foundational drum rudiments, Drumonic teaches you the building blocks of drumming.

Forget pricey subscriptions or complicated setups. Learning to play the drums should be fun and affordable. All you need to get started playing is Drumonic and a pair of sticks. It’s the most budget-friendly way to start drumming today. Each lesson is designed to be bite-sized and engaging so you can level up without getting overwhelmed. Practice just the drums you want, slow down the notes or change their graphics to learn the way you want to learn.

Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 10
  • Processor: Intel i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Minimum graphics card required
  • Storage: 140 MB available space

Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 11
  • Processor: Intel i5 or equivalent
  • Graphics: Minimum graphics card required
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
